subject: Request for SOC 2 Type II report (NDA gating) — audit-window clarifications
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinBridge Security Team <security@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — gating via NDA

Hi Karthik,

FinBridge is kicking off a vendor security review as part of an upcoming platform integration. Could you share Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report? Our procurement/security team requires an executed NDA before we can accept the full report — can you confirm your NDA process and how long it typically takes?

Also, please confirm the audit period covered by the report you would provide. Our review window preference is Jan 2026–Dec 2026, but we can accept adjacent windows if documented. If you have a bridge letter available for audit-period gaps, that would be helpful to understand.

I've attached our questionnaire and intake sheet for context (FinBridge_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx).

Thanks,
Maya Gupta
Senior Security Program Manager
FinBridge

Attachment: FinBridge_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — gating via NDA

Hi Maya — thanks for reaching out and for the questionnaire. Quick answers and next steps: 

- We require an executed NDA before we share the full SOC 2 Type II report. We can either (a) countersign your NDA if you send it, or (b) provide our standard mutual NDA for you to review.
- Typical turnaround for countersigning is 1–2 business days once we have the signed copy back from your side.
- Our latest SOC 2 Type II covers the audit period Jan 1, 2025 — Dec 31, 2025; we can provide a bridge letter describing key control continuities for 2026 if needed.

Please confirm which option you prefer for the NDA (send your signed copy or request our standard NDA). I'm attaching the Redwood NDA template and a short note on how we deliver reports securely once NDA is executed.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Either send your signed NDA to this thread or indicate you want us to issue ours.
2) Confirm the exact audit period FinBridge needs documented (you mentioned Jan–Dec 2026).

If useful, we can schedule a 20–30 minute sync with our security lead (Grace) to walk through the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_nondisclosure_nda_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: redwood_soc2_share_instructions.txt (text/plain)

From: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FinBridge Security Team <security@finbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — gating via NDA

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — attaching our signed mutual NDA (FinBridge_signed_NDA.pdf). We received the intake answers and confirm the audit period we care about is Jan 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026.

Given Redwood's last Type II is Jan–Dec 2025, could you provide a bridge letter that documents relevant control continuities for Jan–Jun 2026 (or until the next Type II becomes available)? We will accept a bridge letter as interim evidence for our legal/compliance team.

Also, can you confirm whether you can provide SIG Lite or CAIQ exports in addition to the SOC report? That would speed our questionnaire review.

Best,
Maya

Attachment: FinBridge_signed_NDA.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@finbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — gating via NDA

Hi Maya — thanks for returning the signed NDA. We have countersigned the attached executed NDA (redwood_executed_nda_signed.pdf) and will proceed with secure delivery. 

Logistics:
- Once countersigned NDA is in place, we provide the SOC 2 Type II report via a secure, time-limited view in our compliance portal or an encrypted PDF delivered to the security contact on file. Expect the link within 2 business days.
- We will produce a short bridge letter that outlines control continuities for Jan–Jun 2026; draft will be ready within 3 business days and we can include it in the same secure package.
- For SIG/CAIQ: we can export a SIG Lite CSV and the CAIQ JSON; Grace (copied) will follow up with the registry export and an internal mapping to your questionnaire fields.

If you'd like, Grace and I can join a 30-minute meeting to walk through the deliverables and answer any questions from FinBridge's security team. Proposed times: Thu 24 Jun 09:00–11:00 PT or Fri 25 Jun 13:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks again — attaching the executed NDA and a short note on the portal link process.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_executed_nda_signed.pdf (application/pdf), redwood_soc2_share_instructions.txt (text/plain)
